Medical Doctor.

Resided upstairs, above his mother at 502 McKenzie Street as a student in 1947.

Resided at 680 Cathedral Avenue with wife Ann as a medical student in 1952.

Aikins Trophy for violin in 1936, on Wpg. Symphony Orchestra, in RCAF, graduated from the U of M in Medicine, practiced in Thunder Bay and Lubbock, Texas.

Retired in Lubbock, Texas.
